Welcome to ECHO
Your music, your way. Songs on your phone and libraries on your NAS all play here.
Add local music
Scan your device or select a music folder. ECHO asks for access when you need it.
Your other libraries, too
Add Subsonic, WebDAV, an SMB share, or Jellyfin / Emby from the library page.
Get closer to the song
Your current song stays within reach while you browse your library.
Open the player
Tap the bottom player to see artwork, playback controls and your queue.
Follow the lyrics
Local lyrics and word-by-word highlighting are supported. Online lyrics can be enabled in settings.
Shape your sound
Equalizer, headphone correction and USB output. Support depends on your device and the audio source.
Lyrics with your music
Artwork · Lyrics · Queue
Take ECHO to your computer
ECHO for PC is on Steam. Connect your computer to speakers or a DAC and let your phone choose and control the music.
ECHO · PC · STEAM
One music experience across phone and computer
After pairing with Echo Link, your phone becomes a pocket remote for ECHO on your computer.
View ECHO on Steam
Browse your computer\'s library and stream it to your phone over the local network
Play, pause, skip and set the volume of your computer from your phone
Send the song playing on your phone to your computer, when both apps support it

ECHO for Android works fine on its own, with or without the PC version. Your phone and computer need to be on the same local network to connect. Buying the Steam version also supports future development.

One last thing
Please ask politely and respectfully.\nNobody owes you anything.
People who answer are spending their own time to help you. Treat that as kindness, not as an obligation.
ASKING WELL
Say hello, describe what happened, and say thanks afterwards
Include your phone model, Android version, ECHO version and the steps to reproduce, ideally with a screenshot or log
Read the README, the docs and existing issues first
PLEASE DON\'T
Insult, mock or attack anyone
Rush or blame people, or demand an instant fix
Post only \"it doesn\'t work\" and wait for an answer
A good question looks like this
Hi! Pixel 8, Android 15, ECHO 1.x. After scanning my SD card, album covers don\'t show. Steps: … Screenshot attached, thank you!
